description: List DNS records in a zone, optionally filtered by type or name.

name.description: DNS record name to filter records by.

per_page.description: Maximum number of DNS records to return per page of results.

type.description: DNS record type (such as A, AAAA, CNAME, or MX) to filter records by.

zone_id.description: Identifier of the zone whose DNS records should be listed.

name: list_dns_records
